description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Freudenberg Performance Materials is part of the Freudenberg Group and a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for a broad range of markets: From apparel, automotive, building materials, civil engineering, energy, filter media, healthcare and to building interiors and more. Join our team and shape the future of innovation with us! Discover our world at www.freudenberg-pm.com.

You support our team as

Procurement Professional

Responsibilities:

  • Execution of the strategy defined by the Commodity / Lead Buyer;
  • Trigger purchase orders based on info records stored in SAP. Follow up purchase orders until goods received (dunning if necessary);
  • Verify and enter order confirmations (quantities and delivery date). If necessary, the Commodity Buyer will adjust/release PO, if price/conditions are not correct;
  • Verify the invoices (quantity variance) and release them if necessary. Release of the invoices with cost and condition variances is carried out by the Commodity Buyer;
  • Compliance assure adherence to the business group requirements and to the OTD target and a low stock level;
  • Forwarding and tracking of Q-notifications internally with quality assurance and externally to the supplier;
  • First contact person for the internal Production Planning, as well as external for the supplier - for quality and delivery date deviations;
  • First contact person for escalations at supplier and Commodity Buyer.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor degree in economics/business administration and/ or at least 2-3 years experience in the procurement of external direct materials is mandatory;
  • Fluent in English, Turkish is nice to have;
  • Understanding of procurement processes;
  • Familiarized with MS Office tools;
  • Experience with SAP (MM module);
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
